value.rationale: Exact optimal nonadaptive placement under independent observation loss is a natural robust Bayes quadrature decision; the global optimum is not trivially the always-delivered or repeated-midpoint design. The proof establishes noncoalescence for each p>0, strict p-dependence and two nontrivial correlation-length regimes, enabling precise location choice. It makes no unsupported broad generalization to >2 queries, unknown kernel, or noisy successful measurements.
